_note: Follower settings for demos/show/follower_server.py and demos.html?show=1. audio_dir is where the show wavs live on THIS machine (absolute path, or relative to the repo root); the page asks for them by basename via GET /show/audio/<file>, searched recursively, so the leader's preshow/ opening-set/ dj-set/ split does not matter. The default points at the show-view checkout beside this one, which is true on both m1 and neo. audible MUST stay false on the TV machine — m1 runs the show's audio, neo makes no sound; the page still analyses the signal because the mute is a GainNode at 0 AFTER the analyser tap, not a muted element.
